title: Chapter 224: Inheriting The Family Business
content:
Chapter 224: Inheriting The Family Business

Now that the two met, Xiao Mo was still optimistic about his grandson.

Looking at Xiao Mo's hopeful gaze, Xiao Yin smiled slightly, turned to look at Xiao Luo and said, "You should have entered the Tiandi Academy, right?"

Hearing Xiao Yin's words, Xiao Luo nodded.

"When you go back to the academy, I will go back with you."

"It just so happened that I haven't been back for a long time."

Xiao Yin did not agree immediately, but said that he would take Xiao Yin back to the academy with him.

Xiao Mo was stunned for a moment, then showed a meaningful smile, stroked his beard, and then turned around and walked towards Xiao Jing and others.

Although the Xiao clan has now perfectly overcome this crisis.

But there are still many local matters within the Xiao clan.

As the current patriarch, I still have a lot to deal with.

Xiao Luo was inexplicably excited at this moment.

Normally, Xiao Yin is not only his local clan sister, but also his local senior sister.

If you go back to Tiandi Academy with Sister Xiao Yin, your status in the Academy will rise sharply.

As a genius of the Xiao clan, he didn't need fame and fortune, but those can be exchanged for more learning resources in the academy.

As the Di Tiandi Academy, known as the transcendent force of the Immortal Realm, even some extremely terrifying major forces will choose to send the geniuses in the power to the Tiandi Academy to study.

Not to mention Xiao Luo, who is in the declining family.

Looking at Xiao Luo who was a little excited in front of him, Xiao Yin smiled helplessly and stepped forward and patted Xiao Luo on the shoulder, "No need to do this. My Xiao clan now looks at the entire fairyland and doesn't need to look at anyone's expression."

This is extremely arrogant, but the Xiao clan does have this strength now.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo couldn't help but feel shocked, and then nodded heavily.

"Sister Yin, I understand."

At this time, Lu Daosheng and his daughter appeared not far away from everyone and slowly walked towards everyone.

When they saw Lu Daosheng, none of the Xiao tribes present dared to ignore it and came forward respectfully.

"Lord Huang City, what else do you have?"

Xiao Chen stepped forward and bowed respectfully, then asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's not a big deal."

"Listen attentively."

Lu Daosheng looked at Xiao Yin and the other two on the side, and then said, "I heard that you two belong to the Tiandi Academy?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's question, Xiao Yin did not dare to be careless and nodded, "Yes."

"Since that's the case, I plan to let my daughter go to that academy to study."

Lu Daosheng pointed to Lu Xue with his eyes rolling around.

Looking at Lu Xue's careless look, Lu Daosheng sighed in his heart.

When will you grow up?

"Senior Lu, Xiao Luo and I are just about to go back to the academy. Why don't you let me take Miss Lu to the academy with me."

At this time, Xiao Yin went forward and recommended himself.

She knew very well how much energy the person in front of her had.

Even if he is an ancestor of his own Xiao clan, he still has to bow his head when he sees it. Can he be a simple person?

In this way, we must try our best to make friends.

Looking at Xiao Yin in front of him, he took the initiative to show his favor.

Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment, then agreed.

"That's thank you for your hard work."

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin waved his hands repeatedly, "It's not hard work. You saved my entire Xiao clan. These are nothing."

And Lu Daosheng laughed.

"With your current strength, it's definitely not as simple as a student in that academy, right?"

At that time, Xiao Yin's strength in the Immortal Lord Realm was just a student in the academy.

Now, after a million years, Xiao Yin has broken out of his cocoon and become a butterfly in the Xiao clan's ancestral land, breaking through to the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm. Even if he looks at the entire fairyland, he can be regarded as a giant harbor.

With such strength, how could he be just a student after returning to the academy?

These words made the Xiao tribe around him gradually react.

Then he looked at Xiao Yin, his eyes full of light.

Xiao Yin nodded with a smile, "Don't worry, Senior Lu, in the academy, Xiao Yin will definitely take care of Miss Lu."

"Of course, with your strength, the entire academy will basically not dare to bully Miss Lu, unless it is those who are blind."

Xiao Yin was very smart and immediately understood Lu Daosheng's intention.

Lu Daosheng looked at Xiao Yin in front of him deeply and said, "This is reasonable, but I still hope to be more low-key. Do you understand what I mean?"

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin nodded and said, "I understand."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng felt relieved.

"Xiaoxue, my dad won't give it to you."

Turning around and looking at Lu Xue, Lu Daosheng touched Lu Xue's head and then spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Xue said quietly: "I don't believe it. I guess you will follow you secretly again, just like this time."

These words made everyone present want to laugh.

But due to Lu Daosheng's pressure, everyone had to hold it in.

Lu Daosheng's face also froze.

This girl has guessed it.

"cough."

Lu Daosheng coughed lightly and then said seriously: "Xiaoxue, didn't you say you wanted to go out and try it out by yourself? Dad will let you try this time, and I guarantee you won't care about you."

"Of course, if you can't hold on, just go back to the deserted city to inherit the family business. Don't think about what's there all day long, and whether you hear it."

On the side, the Xiao clan's faces were frozen, and his heart was extremely complicated.

Listen, do you say it?

Please make sure that this poor life dominated by them will also feel it.

But at this time, Lu Xue sighed, "I know, I know."

Suddenly, the Xiao clan members were shocked again.

You even sighed, if I had such a powerful father, I would look at people with my nostrils when I went out.

Everyone thought so.

Unfortunately, the reality is a bit unsatisfactory.

Even if you are in such a large force, you still need to obtain resources through your own efforts, and the descendants of the clan leader are no exception.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly, "That dad is gone."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng did not hesitate, and directly trembled and disappeared from the spot.

Seeing this, everyone in the Xiao clan said respectfully: "We are here to give it to you."

Seeing that his father really left directly, Lu Xue was slightly stunned, and then the young actor snorted: "If you don't give it, don't give it. Wait for your daughter, Lu Xue's name to resound throughout the fairyland."

At this time, Xiao Yin said, "Miss Lu, please wait for a moment, and we will set off in a while."

I planned to stay in the clan for a few days before returning to the academy.

But now that she has agreed to Lu Daosheng, she naturally dare not delay.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue waved her hand and said, "It's okay, I'm not in a hurry. I'm just in time for you Xiao clan to have a good time."

As soon as he came to the Xiao clan, Lu Xue went straight into the ancestral land and had not yet taken a good look at what the so-called ancient Xiao clan looked like.

Xiao Yin was also happy to hear Lu Xue say this.

"Xiao Luo, you can take Miss Lu around the Xiao clan and step on foot anywhere. Be sure to take care of Miss Lu."

"Don't worry, Sister Yin."

Xiao Luo immediately patted his chest and promised.
